text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — Customer Delta wants an onramp: private control plane + dedicated GPUs, target EoQ. Need to align cross-team must-haves and what we can ship as an MVP. Who blocks what?

Ravi (Eng): short list from eng: stable public API + greenfield route for tenant isolation, feature-flagged rollout, end-to-end perf tests, dashboard hooks for errors. Timeline depends on infra gating.

Leo (Runtime): runtime needs: 1) model variant and quantization profile selected; 2) perf bench (p95 latency + tokens/sec) on the dedicated shape; 3) KV cache + prefix cache enabled for tenant; 4) canary path that falls back to hosted model. If any of those are missing we can't promise latency SLOs.

Carla (Infra): infra blockers: VPC peering + private control-plane subnet, tenant storage encryption at-rest, routable NATs for container images, and capacity reservation numbers (how many GPUs / region?). Also need a Jira: INFRA-4723 created for networking prep.

Sam (Security): security gating: KMS/HSM integration for keys, audit logs exported to the customer's SIEM, SLA for log retention (customer asked 1 year), threat-model signoff, and a scoped pen-test before GA. For MVP we can accept timeboxed compensating controls but need doc signoff.

Maya (PM): ok, sounds like we should split this into two phases: Phase A = "private control plane + basic dedicated capacity" (minimal security controls + canary), Phase B = "full enterprise hardening (KMS+pen-test+1yr logs)". Agree?

Ravi (Eng): agree. Phase A scope: API + feature flag + canary route + metrics. Estimate: 3 sprints if infra delivers the VPC and capacity.

Carla (Infra): we can queue INFRA-4723 for next sprint. Need committed GPU counts to allocate (estimate required: 4x A100-equivalent across us-west-2). If product commits, we can reserve and provide a date.

Leo (Runtime): +1 on phasing. For Phase A we can run quantized model (8-bit) to reduce cost; need eval run on sample prompts from Customer Delta. Can someone attach prompt set?

Maya (PM): attaching sample prompts to the ticket and cc'ing the customer success lead. Also adding prompt eval to EVAL-2101.

Sam (Security): for Phase A we'll accept short-lived keys + enhanced logging to our internal retention for 90 days. Phase B must include KMS integration and pen-test. I'll draft the security checklist.

Ravi (Eng): owners and action items then:
- API/flag work: Ravi (ENG) -> ENG-901
- Runtime perf + quant eval: Leo (RUNTIME) -> RUNTIME-338
- Infra networking + capacity reserve: Carla (INFRA) -> INFRA-4723
- Security checklist + temporary controls: Sam (SEC) -> SEC-220
- PM orchestration + customer comms: Maya (PM) -> PROD-511

DeployBot: scheduled a canary window for Phase A: tentative 2026-06-15 03:00 UTC (subject to infra ready).

Maya (PM): next sync Thursday 10am PT. If any team can't hit their ticket in time call out blockers before EOD Tuesday.

Leo (Runtime): small ask — if we go 8-bit, quality validation must include regeneration checks (top-k recall on 300 prompts). I'll add details in RUNTIME-338.

Carla (Infra): noted. I'll update INFRA-4723 with GPU counts and peering checklist by Mon.

Sam (Security): starting checklist now; will post required docs and a short compensating-control template for Phase A.

Ravi (Eng): ping me if any APIs need breaking changes; prefer adapter layer to avoid client churn.

Maya (PM): perfect, thanks. Recording owners in the ticket and I'll follow up with a short one-pager for the customer. :thumbsup:
